title: Digital Assets - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the Digital Assets market is projected to reach US$100.8bn in 2026.
The average revenue per user in the Digital Assets market amounts to US$128.8 in 2026.
From a global comparison perspective it is shown that the highest revenue is reached United States (US$17.8bn in 2026).
In the Digital Assets market, the number of users is expected to amount to 795.87m users by 2027.
User penetration will be 9.90% in 2026 and is expected to hit 9.99% by 2027.
